why_not_a_protocol_amendment: TASK-20260801-069 COULD have issued a versioned protocol_amendment narrowing precondition 1 to its substance, and DID NOT. Narrowing a reviewer's precondition in the direction that lets the batch proceed, decided by the party the precondition constrains, is exactly the latitude this campaign has spent three batches removing. If precondition 1 is to be narrowed, an independent session must do it on the merits.
